justifications.durability: tests/test_doccheck_slug_collision.py:85 and :126 are red at base 327ce7a6 and again in logs/evidence-neg.log once _collision_context is removed, and each asserts an exit code and printed finding text rather than any value the test itself passed in.
justifications.evidence: the five gate logs under the run directory record revision, literal command and a bare EXIT= for every arm; I re-measured ruff 0.16.4 on both changed files at each revision and got 17 findings and a clean format check at both, matching the manifest, though no ruff log is stored.
justifications.fit: reckon/doccheck.py:2769 keeps the module's private-helper idiom and no plan, section or ticket identifier appears in the added code, tests or comments.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/doccheck.py:2813-2823 loads the mounts once and resolves each audited path through _collision_context, so a bare audit reaches slug_collision_findings and refuses a colliding research record.
justifications.reuse: _declared_project now delegates to reckon/_plan_html.py:2579 parse_plan, extending the repository's single meta reader rather than re-reading docs-project itself.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff is one of the three the review goal names, but tests/test_doccheck_slug_collision.py sits outside the dispatch's declared fence even though plan section 12 declares it.
